item.title: A beginners guide to rucking, the latest practical fitness trend
item.description: Rucking is walking with weight on your back.

item.title: Couple gifts 100-acre tree farm to Washington State University
item.description: On a trip through North East Washington in the 1970s, couple Lynn and Becky Miner fell in love with the stunning nature around them.

item.title: Netanyahu visits Washington to weigh in on Trump's negotiations on Iran
item.description: President Trump has threatened to attack Iran after its brutal crackdown on protesters, but the U.S. is also seeking a deal with Iran

item.title: How Aura V, the youngest-ever Grammy winner, navigates music, school and performing with her dad
item.description: The father-daughter duo's music focuses on positivity, inclusion, community and friendship.

item.title: Before Billie Jean King, Arthur Ashe and the Williams sisters, there was Althea Gibson
item.description: Althea Gibson is a pioneer in women's sports known for breaking the color barrier in tennis and the Ladies Professional Golf Association, as well as her victories at the U.S. Open, French Open and Wimbledon in the late 1950s.

item.title: Oldest known whale song recordings discovered in Cape Cod archives
item.description: The files, found on a bygone piece of audio recording equipment, may give scientists new evidence about how humans have changed the ocean.

item.title: Mass. lawmakers warn growing health care costs, ‘unhelpful’ federal government threaten state budget
item.description: Massachusetts lawmakers tasked with crafting the state’s yearly budget warned that growing health care costs and a “very unhelpful” federal government are creating challenging spending decisions and threatening the local economy.

item.title: Brainwaves: Is AI actually thinking?
item.description: The rate at which artificial intelligence is able to replicate human behavior has increased in recent years. Does that mean it's thinking like us? In the third episode of "Brainwaves," what artificial intelligence teaches us about our own capacity for thought.

item.title: American wife of Irish man detained by ICE asks for his release
item.description: The wife of Seamus Culleton, a 38-year-old Irish man who has lived in the Boston area for nearly 20 years, is urging federal immigration officials to release her husband after ICE agents arrested him in September.

item.title: Jury finds ex-Worcester councilor Haxhiaj guilty of assaulting police officer during ICE arrest
item.description: Jurors found Etel Haxhiaj guilty on the misdemeanor charge and acquitted her on a separate charge of interfering with law enforcement after a two-day trial in Worcester District Court.
